title: PALEOMAP Paleodigital Elevation Models for the Phanerozoic

selectedFrame.ageDisclosure: The archive member name says 65 Ma while the NetCDF global description says 66 Ma. Both source values are retained; the application labels this as the 65 Ma archive frame with a 66 Ma internal-description boundary and never silently chooses one as more authoritative.

canonicalGrid.transformation: Each source float32 value was verified finite and exactly integral, then stored losslessly as one signed 16-bit metre value in the original north-to-south, west-to-east row order. The final source column is retained even though the visual Web Mercator pyramid samples the half-open [-180, 180) longitude interval.

visualization.resampling: bilinear from the retained 0.1 degree metre grid
visualization.maximumZoomGroundSampling: approximately 0.088 degrees per display pixel at the equator
visualization.selectionPolicy: The sole prototype frame is available only within half of the source's stated five-million-year cadence. No temporal interpolation or extrapolation is performed.

scientificLimitations: This is a modelled PaleoDEM interpretation, not measured ancient elevation or bathymetry and not an uncertainty surface.
The colour tiles are a bilinearly resampled Web Mercator visualization; the checksummed canonical grid retains the source metre values and polar rows.
Web Mercator tiles do not display latitudes poleward of approximately 85.051 degrees, although those source cells remain in the canonical grid.
This PALEOMAP frame is independent of CAO2024 geometry and observations and of PBDB paleocoordinates. Overlay does not imply model co-registration.
Coastlines, continental polygons, continent-ocean boundaries, plate partitions and observation points do not become elevation or bathymetry by proximity to this grid.
Only one source frame is shipped by this prototype. It must not be described as continuous 540-0 Ma terrain coverage.
